evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creation story for a game; no concrete requirement-level dependency on another backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators requires an existing game to which the URL refers.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round requires an existing game/session.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing all items requires items to have been added to the game.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item requires an existing list of items in a game.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding an item is an action within a game and requires an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item requires an item to exist from an earlier add/import story.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item requires an existing item in the list.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates requires an existing game/round in which estimates are collected.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting estimates requires an existing game/round and estimate collection.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic fill requires an existing game/round with estimates.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering an agreed estimate requires an existing game/round and estimation context.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating requires a previously estimated item and round.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories into a game requires an existing game/session.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copying stories into a game requires an existing game/session.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games requires games to have been created and stored.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript requires an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a game transcript requires an existing game/transcript.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a game transcript requires an existing game/transcript.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game requires an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is self-contained with respect to other backlog stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requires an account to exist.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing account details requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an account requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a self-contained presentation concern without a concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder requires an existing account.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the estimation scale is a game setting and requires an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators depends on the invitation feature and an existing game.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining a game requires a game and an invitation URL.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimators can only see an item after it has been added/selected for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Viewing all items requires items to have been added to the game.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Seeing estimate status requires an existing game/round and estimation activity.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Displaying all estimates requires an existing game/round and collected estimates.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate requires an existing game/round with an estimate draw.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates requires existing estimation history in a game.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Viewing current-round attribution requires estimates from an ongoing game/round.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: A participant timer requires an existing game/participant context.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Resetting a two-minute timer inherently depends on the timer feature.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Scrolling through prior rounds requires prior rounds/items to exist.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering across draws requires an existing game/draw context.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Changing an estimate requires an existing game/round and draw.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a photo near played cards requires an existing game/card-play context.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained quality requirement; no concrete prerequisite story.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained documentation item.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Technical performance work; no concrete requirement-level dependency cited.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained compatibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained accessibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained performance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained internationalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained usability requirement.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Self-contained error-handling requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing results non-identifiably requires game/result data to exist.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Usage metrics require game usage data from existing game functionality.
